'''Lure Monster''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Upkeep Phase''': You may cast and exhaust while in Arkham to choose one [[monster]] on the board (including the [[Sky]], but not the [[Outskirts]]).  Move that monster to your current space.
